svg.text: #604 Enterprise Telecom & NOC AIOps: 50B Logs/Day 3-Stage Funnel & Topology Graph RCA
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 578,000 Logs/s → Drain3 Template (420/s) → CMDB Topology Storm Collapse (0.85 QPS) → 4× H200 RCA
1. The 99.9998% 3-Stage AIOps Alarm Funnel
Stage 1 (578,000 raw logs/s → 420 bursts/s): Drain3 Log Template Parser
• Strips dynamic IPs/timestamps into fixed AST log templates on CPU in 0.4ms
• Sliding-window z-score anomaly detector achieves 1,376x volume reduction
Stage 2 (420 bursts/s → 0.85 Root Incidents/s): CMDB Topology Correlator
• 1 core optical fiber cut triggers 800 downstream 5G base-station/leaf switch alarms
• Upstream dependency graph traversal collapses 800 symptom alarms into 1 root ticket!
Stage 3 (0.85 Incident-QPS): DeepSeek-R1 / 72B Root-Cause & Runbook Agent
• Queries historical postmortems + executes read-only diagnostic CLI probes
• Requires ONLY 4× H200 ($13.6k/mo) · Cuts NOC MTTR from 48.0m to 4.2m (11.4x faster!)
2. Safe Network & K8s Remediation Guardrails
Read-Only Diagnostic Autonomy vs. Write-Action Dry-Run Gate
• Tier-A Whitelisted Read Commands (show bgp summary, kubectl get events, ping):
100% Autonomous execution by the RCA Agent in <3 seconds
• Tier-B State-Mutating Commands (BGP route drain, interface shut, helm rollback):
Mandatory Batfish / Digital-Twin Simulation + 1-Click Engineer Approval Card!
50B Logs/Day NOC Infrastructure TCO Comparison
• Naive "Send Uncollapsed Alarms to 70B LLM": 420 QPS → 160× H200 ($544,000/mo)
• 3-Stage Funnel Fleet: 8× CPU Nodes (Drain3 + Graph, $1.6k) + 4× H200 ($13.6k)
= $15,200/month (-97.2% Cost Reduction · Saves $6.35M/year!)
• Root-Cause Localization Accuracy @ Top-1 rises from 58.4% (flat logs) to 95.6%
3. Why CMDB Topology Storm Suppression Is Mandatory Before LLM RCA
• Without topology correlation, 1 fiber cut spawns 800 parallel LLM agent investigations that hallucinate 800 conflicting leaf fixes.
• Collapsing child alarms onto the highest upstream fault node in the CMDB DAG lifts Top-1 RCA accuracy by +37.2 pts.
